items.description: The routes module (app/routes/) contains no import of SQLAlchemy Session or any ORM construct
The services module (app/services/) contains no import of SQLAlchemy Session or any ORM construct
DATABASE_URL is read from the environment variable and is not hardcoded anywhere in the application source
POST a new SKU/location/quantity creates a stock record and GET returns the same SKU, location, and quantity
POST a payload with a negative quantity returns an HTTP error response body that names the offending field
POST a payload missing the required sku field returns an HTTP error response body that names the offending field
Navigating <App> to the file-stock route renders the file-stock form with a data-testid='sku-input' element
Navigating <App> to the file-stock route renders the file-stock form with a data-testid='location-input' element
Navigating <App> to the file-stock route renders the file-stock form with a data-testid='quantity-input' element
Navigating <App> to the file-stock route renders the file-stock form with a data-testid='file-stock-submit' submit control
The stock service rejects a write with a negative quantity value before any database write occurs
Inserting two rows with the same (sku, location) pair into the stock table raises a unique-constraint violation on the real branch database
Inserting a row with quantity below zero into the stock table raises a check-constraint violation on the real branch database
Inserting a row with a NULL sku into the stock table raises a not-null-constraint violation on the real branch database
Running the stock table migration downgrade followed immediately by upgrade recreates the stock table with all required columns and constraints on the real branch database
GET a stock record filed with a combined inventory_code returns the inventory_code exactly as filed
Navigating <App> to the file-stock route renders the file-stock form with a data-testid='inventory-code-input' element
POST the same SKU/location with a different quantity updates the existing record in place and GET returns exactly one record with the new quantity
A refile of an existing (sku, location) pair results in exactly one row in the stock table — no duplicate is inserted — verified on the real branch database
The stock service list method returns an empty Python list (not raises, not None) when no stock rows exist in the database
GET /stock returns a JSON array containing one object per filed stock record with sku, location, and quantity fields (seeded with a per-run-unique key)
GET /stock returns a JSON array that is empty when no stock records have been filed
rendering <App> in MemoryRouter at '/' with mocked stock data shows the stock table element in the document
rendering <App> in MemoryRouter at '/' with mocked stock data shows one table row per stock record
rendering <App> in MemoryRouter at '/' with mocked stock data shows each row's SKU cell with its data-testid carrying the correct SKU value
rendering <App> in MemoryRouter at '/' with mocked stock data shows each row's location cell with its data-testid carrying the correct location value
rendering <App> in MemoryRouter at '/' with mocked stock data shows each row's quantity cell with its data-testid carrying the correct quantity value
the quantity cell carries the design-guide CSS class (not an inline style) that implements right-alignment
rendering <App> in MemoryRouter at '/' with empty stock data shows the empty-state element with its data-testid
rendering <App> in MemoryRouter at '/' with empty stock data shows the text 'No stock at this location' in the empty-state element
